observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: bright dance studio with white walls, wooden floor, and large white double doors at the back
observation.dancers: six young women, mixed group in colourful character costumes
observation.formation_and_space: line formation facing forward across the studio width, occasionally shifting to pairs or brief diagonal spreads
observation.posture: upright torso with soft knees, weight shifting dynamically with high energy pop choreography
observation.footwork: stepping side-to-side, skipping in place, jumping on beats, and deep squatting steps
observation.arms_and_hands: expressive pop choreography with arms reaching overhead, pointing, waving, and framing the face; holding balloons and props later in the video
observation.hips_and_torso: hip sways, bounces in low squat positions, and upper body turns
observation.partnering: none, except occasional hand-holding or playful interaction in pairs
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent high jumps with legs tucked or extended, low squats, and spins
observation.costume_and_props: anime/cartoon character cosplay outfits featuring brightly colored skirts, boots, hats, and wigs; holding balloons and balloon animals
observation.cannot_infer: fast footwork detail obscured by wide camera angles and rapid editing cuts

signature_moments.what: Synchronized high jump with arms raised high overhead
Dancers drop into a low squat position with knees bent wide
Quick directional stomp and pivot with arm gestures
